reference.name: ESCHER-GPU
reference.build: its own Makefile (parity/references.toml: make all-types build/cbst_test ARCH=sm_86)

protocol.order: A/B alternation (A first in every round)

clocks.how: ncu --clock-control base on parity/clock_lock/clock_holder.cu (idle, one kernel) for the whole A/B; the timed programs are not profiled
clocks.check: every busy GPU sample of every accepted round at the locked clocks

protocol.lock: perf.lock: held exclusively by this process
protocol.guard: every round (accepted or repeated): the counts A prints and the port prints equal the golden case's; a failure stops the reading

regions.note: A: update.maintain minus its maintain.* sub-stages; port: host_model_ms (outside the update timer)
A: update.maintain minus its maintain.* sub-stages; port: host_model_ms (outside the update timer)
A: update.maintain minus its maintain.* sub-stages; port: host_model_ms (outside the update timer)

monitor.rule: a round is repeated if, during either side, the CPUs were busy outside the harness for more than 2.0 cores on average or a foreign compute process was on the timed GPU

audit.rule: a round is flagged when the 1-minute load average exceeds 16.0 or procs_blocked exceeds 4 at the start or end of either side, or a foreign compute process was on the timed GPU; a flagged reading is taken again (ADR 0056)

input.how: the dataset file $DYNG_SCRATCH/datasets/hyper/coauth.hg, hashed by the measuring process
